content.text: {"id": "mm4945a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the number of confirmed cases of polio reported through September 2000 in the EMR has decreased by approximately 50% (from 619 to 314)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the regional reported coverage with at least three doses of oral poliovirus vaccine (OPV3) by age 1 year was 83%"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "ocr", "q": "Number of persons with AFP per 100,000 population aged <15 years."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the annualized nonpolio AFP reporting rates during 2000 have exceeded one"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the regional reported coverage with at least three doses of oral poliovirus vaccine (OPV3) by age 1 year was 83%"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "two adequate stool samples were collected from 67% and 71% of the reported persons with AFP"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The regional average reporting rates for nonpolio AFP in 1999 and 2000 are 1.1 and 1.3 (annualized), respectively."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Compared with the same period in 1999, the number of confirmed cases of polio reported through September 2000"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "( > 1 nonpolio AFP case per 100,000 children aged <15 years)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All member countries have established acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) surveillance."}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This report summarizes progress toward this goal from January 1999 through September 2000."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "( > 1 nonpolio AFP case per 100,000 children aged <15 years)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Laboratory results were reported on time (within 28 days of receipt of specimen)"}, {"loc": "ocr", "q": "Minimum expected rate is one case of"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
